Tick 0 Prepare
  consumes: px.demo.csv
  internal: -
  produces: px.demo.rows:new-address:-
  calculations: fn.demo.load@-
  latency: latency_ms=1.000 mode=parallel

Tick 1 Fan
  consumes: px.demo.rows
  internal: -
  produces: px.demo.left:new-address:-,px.demo.right:new-address:-
  calculations: fn.demo.left@-,fn.demo.right@-
  latency: latency_ms=3.000 mode=parallel

Tick 2 Score
  consumes: px.demo.left,px.demo.right
  internal: -
  produces: px.demo.score:new-address:-
  calculations: fn.demo.score@-
  latency: latency_ms=0.500 mode=parallel
